extracted.intended_audience: NIH ASSIST users (applicants, institutional grants administrators, program staff preparing/submitting NIH grant applications)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance and validation rules for entering, editing, saving, and managing component forms, budgets, attachments, optional forms, and component order within NIH's ASSIST application system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms-I vs Forms-H usage
rubrics_metrics.description: The forms in these topics reflect FORMS-I, which must be used for applications with due dates on or after January 25, 2025 (see guide notice NOT-OD-24-086). For due dates on or before January 24, 2025, use FORMS-H.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the annotated form set and summary of changes for Forms-I and the guide notice to determine which form set applies to your application due date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruitment Plan to Enhance Diversity attachment (page-limit treatment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Added Recruitment Plan to Enhance Diversity attachment to Training Program Section. Moving this information into a separate attachment means it no longer counts towards the Program Plan page limit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the Recruitment Plan as the separate attachment designated in Forms-I so it is excluded from the Program Plan page-count; follow attachment guidance when adding in ASSIST.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment management (Add/Delete/View Attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach the applicable sections of the research plan using the Add Attachment buttons. Use the Delete Attachment buttons to remove attachments or the View Attachment buttons to view them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Add Attachment control to upload each required attachment; remove or view attachments as needed prior to saving or submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save behavior and form locking
rubrics_metrics.description: To save entered information, select the Save and Keep Lock button to keep the form open for further editing -or- select the Save and Release Lock button to close the form after saving. Selecting the Cancel and Release Lock button - followed by the Continue button on the confirmation - returns the form to read-only and does not save any of the entered information onto the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose Save and Keep Lock when you will continue editing; choose Save and Release Lock to close the form. Beware that Cancel and Release Lock + Continue discards unsaved changes and returns the form to read-only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget tab visibility depends on budget authority
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST users who have been granted budget authority (View or Edit) may add, edit, and/or view budget information using the [specific] Budget tab. If a user does not have the View or Edit budget authority, the Budget tab does not display among the tabs for other component forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure appropriate budget authority (View or Edit) is granted to users who need to access budgeting tabs; otherwise those tabs will not appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add Budget Period behavior (auto-populate)
rubrics_metrics.description: When adding additional budget periods, the information from the previous budget period is carried over and auto-populated into the fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Add Period button (available in Edit mode) to create subsequent budget periods, then edit auto-populated values as necessary for the new period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing and viewing budget periods
rubrics_metrics.description: To edit budget information: select the link for the period to view or edit (e.g., Period 3 link), select the Edit button to enable editing, update the budget information as necessary, then save using Save and Keep Lock or Save and Release Lock.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*). Use the period links to access specific periods for correction or update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleting a budget period
rubrics_metrics.description: With Edit Budget authority, a user may remove entire budget periods from a component by selecting the period link, selecting Edit, clicking Remove Budget Period, confirming in the confirmation window (Continue), and noting the removed period disappears from the Cumulative Budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting Go Back cancels the deletion. Deleting a budget period permanently removes its data from the component and cumulative calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing cumulative budget (read-only)
rubrics_metrics.description: To view the cumulative budget of multiple budget periods, select the Cumulative link. The PHS [Budget] - Cumulative Budget displays as read-only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If changes are needed to the cumulative totals, make edits at the individual budget period level rather than in the cumulative view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training Subaward Budget: add and manage subawards
rubrics_metrics.description: The Training Subaward Budget form must be added to the component as an optional form. To add a subaward click Add New Subaward, complete the budget information (required fields marked with *), save, and repeat Add New Subaward for each additional subaward. Added subawards display in a table accessible via Edit, Remove, and View buttons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add each subaward via the Add New Subaward control; manage multiple subawards from the table. Use Add Period within a subaward to create additional periods for that subaward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removing individual or all training subaward budgets
rubrics_metrics.description: To remove an individual subaward click the Remove button for that subaward and confirm. To remove all subawards click Remove all Subawards and confirm. Confirmation windows display; Continue completes removal and Go Back cancels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm carefully; removals delete the subaward entries from the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional form removal is permanent
rubrics_metrics.description: The PHS [Optional] form is an optional form which can be removed if not needed. IMPORTANT: Removing the form deletes the form and all its contents from the application. This action cannot be reversed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only remove an optional form if you are certain; use the Remove Form button and confirm with the Continue button to proceed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field data format validations (immediate field-level checks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Many component form fields require certain types of data (e.g., numeric data in salary fields). ASSIST validates the data upon entry (or after moving the cursor from the field) and immediately displays a pop-alert indicating that the format is not as expected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a format error occurs read the error message and select OK. The field containing the error remains red and cannot be navigated away from until the erroneous data is fixed or cleared out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required field validations and saving with missing required data
rubrics_metrics.description: Required fields are marked with a red asterisk (*). Although the information in these fields is required for submission, component forms can be saved without this information. When saving a form with missing required fields, a notice displays indicating that data entry errors were found and providing the options to Continue saving the form as-is or to Return to correct errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may save a form in-progress without all required fields, but be aware submission validation will later require completion. Use component validation prior to final submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing information icon on summary page
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST employs a missing information icon - a red exclamation point (!) - on the summary page of incomplete component forms. The icon indicates the section or field with missing data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the icon appears on the summary page, edit the indicated section or field and provide the required information before saving again.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add Optional Forms availability is opportunity-specific
rubrics_metrics.description: Depending on the funding opportunity, optional forms may exist for both single- and multi-project applications. Only the optional forms available for the specific funding opportunity can be added. Use Add Optional Form to select from the drop-down list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For single-project applications add optional forms from the Actions panel. For multi-project applications return to Application Info, expand the component, then use Add Optional Form to add forms to that component.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change Component Order rules (multi-project only)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Change Component Order screen is used to set the order in which your components appear in the submitted application (PDF) for each particular component type. This topic is applicable only to multi-project applications. You can re-arrange components within a particular component type, but you cannot re-arrange the order of component types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access Change Component Order from the Actions panel, select the component type, and reorder components that are in status Work in Progress, Complete, or Final.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Assignment Request form purpose and visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The PHS Assignment Request form is used for capturing assignment requests and replaces certain information from the application cover letter attachment. It should be used to: request an assignment to an institute/center for funding consideration; request an assignment to a specific study section for initial peer review; identify individuals who may not be appropriate to review the application; identify scientific areas of expertise needed to review the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form is only visible to receipt and referral staff and scientific review officers, who may need to act on the information. Add it via Add Optional Form and complete required fields as marked.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR form: question specificity
rubrics_metrics.description: Some questions on the SBIR/STTR Information form are specific to either SBIR or STTR applications. This is indicated on the screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the required fields (marked with *) for the appropriate program type; use the on-screen indicators and Manage Attachments help topic if attachments are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Costs pop-up entry
rubrics_metrics.description: To access the Indirect Costs pop-up screen for entering cost information click the Add Indirect Cost button. Enter the data fields on the Indirect Costs pop-up window; required fields are marked with an asterisk (*). Click the Add button when finished.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeat the Add Indirect Cost steps to include all necessary indirect cost types. Save using the standard Save and Keep Lock or Save and Release Lock options.
